book.name: LUKAS
book.title: LUKAS Lukas nu pasa mayenu Yesus Kristus tuku kuyarna

content: Yesus nu maŋ tiŋgina
Nane piro tugu palmbinu ait mbolŋge pino kame gureŋ kuanekinaig ta kilmba maratukuk tiŋga ndame burok tugum kinaig kande
ndame suŋgo buk talka barinaig le kasomŋge minna le kaŋgernaig.
Nane burok ta sinam kumba Suŋgo Yesus tuku mindesiŋ nda kaŋgernaig.
Nane wamdus te-sulumba minnaig le kile taŋgo armba tawi kilŋa ŋak bitek promba nane tugumŋge tiŋginaik le
nane ndek nale kaŋgerka kuru-kuruka lokinaig le taŋgo ar taŋge saniŋginaik: Ndaŋam kumanu ma mbolŋge taŋgo abo ŋak sotade. Nu buk tiŋgat. Teŋge mine ndakate.
O buk nu Galileaŋge pasa satiŋgina ta idus ndade? Nane ye Ndindo Katesek Taŋgo tumba wam ŋaigonu kanu mbal tuku wai mbolŋge pilwaig le
ail kazrai mbolŋge nil daŋŋguwaig le ye kumi sulumba mara keŋnu mbolŋge maŋ tinuŋgit ŋgina ŋga saniŋginaik.
Taŋakinaik le pino kame Yesus tuku pasa buk saniŋgina le isnaig ta maŋ idusnaig.
Nane ndame burok kusremba luka kumba nuŋe dubinaig taŋgo 11 nane taŋgo pino afu turmba kila saniŋginaig.
Pino kame ta Maria Magdalanu, Yohana, Maria ande Yakobus tuku ina nuŋe nane pino afu turmba. Nane aposel kame ndoŋ wam kubeu niŋginaig ta
nane ismba ake ndinŋge pasa ŋga son nda ŋginaig.
[Petrus nu tiŋga pinder ŋak ŋak kumba ndame burok tugum promba bafuka mindesiŋ soŋganu tawi ta ake minnaig le kaŋgerkina. Taŋamba nu idus-idusmba luka tumbraŋ kina.]
Nale Emaus ndinŋge Yesus kaŋgernaik
Ki ndui ta mbolŋge nale armba Emaus tumbraŋ kambim tuku kinaik. Yerusalemŋge Emaus kambim tuku kuennu ki kanum armba taŋaŋ kinaik.
Nale kumbaŋge wam ŋakmba pronaig ta saka saka kinaik.
Taŋamba nale pasata muŋgu kusnaŋga kumba minnaik le Yesus nuŋe miroŋ pro nale ndoŋ kina.
Nale tuku am tukulnikina le nale nu kaŋgermba pulu ndanikina.
Kile nu nale kusnanikina: Tale ame wam tuku saka saka kinik ŋgina le nale tiŋga tumail pasi kiri-kareka piti ŋak taŋaŋ mambilnaik le kaŋgerkina le
inumŋge nyunu Kleopas nu Yesus sana: Yoi. Yerusalem pronaig mbal nane ŋakmba wam kame ailfu mayok kinaig ta kaŋgerkinaig. Ne aniŋge minna ŋgina.

Taŋakina le nu nale sanikina: Ame wam kinaig ŋgina le nale sanaik: Nasaretnu taŋgo Yesus nu mbolŋge wam kinaig. Nu tuan taŋgo suŋgo. Nu tuku pasa wam ke likina ta Kuate am mbolŋge taŋgo am mbolŋge saŋgrinu mayok kina.
Siŋgine pris gabat mbal siŋgine sugo ŋakmba nu tumba pasa mbolŋge te-timba nu kumwa ŋga sakinaig le ail kazrai mbolŋge nil daŋŋginaig le kumna.
Nu Israel mbal tuku muskil kile-tidiŋguwa ko ŋga tapraka idusmba mingeŋ. Ta ndo kuga. Wam afu turmba. Ait armba buk kinaik le kile keŋnu.
Siŋgine pino afu wam ande sakaig le sine ismba piriri ŋayowig. Kite maratukuk tiŋga nane ndame burok tugum kumba
Yesus tuku mindesiŋ kaŋger ndawaig. Nane kiŋatanu suk eŋel armba kaŋgerkaig le eŋelŋge nu abo minit ŋga saniŋganu sakaig. Nane taŋamba pro kubeu siŋgaig.
Siŋgine mbal afu tiŋga kumba ka wam ta kumu-kumumba kaŋgeraig ta Yesus kaŋger ndawaig ŋga sanaik.
Nale taŋamba sakinaik le Yesus nu sanikina: Tale ŋginŋgan taŋgo. Kristus nu rar suŋgo tam kumuŋ. Nu taŋawa le nuŋe nyu suŋgo mayok kaŋgat. Ndaŋam tale tuan taŋgo tuku kuyar son nda ŋgade ŋgina.
Taŋaka Yesus nu Moses le tuan taŋgo ŋakmba tuku kuyar ta mbolŋge tugu pilmba kuyar pasa nu tuku sakade ta ŋakmba bitekŋgina.
Nane pasata ka Emaus tumbraŋ patumba Yesus nu tumbraŋ limba kambim bafuna le
nale saŋgri tiŋga sanaik: Nda kaye. Buk furirte. Ne sile ndoŋ teŋge kinybe ŋginaik le nu nale ndoŋ wandek kinaig.
Taŋamba nane isukusam bafumba Yesus nu bret tumba Kuate gare pasa tumba fetfetmba nale nikina le
kile nale am purfenikina le nu kaŋgermba katesenaik le nu pitik ndo ŋgisika kina.
Taŋana le nale nakile nakile muŋgu kaŋgerka sakinaik: O son. Sine ndinŋge ilmba kuyar pasa tugunu sake likat le gare suŋgo kamuskik ŋginaik.
Kile nale pastiŋga luka Yerusalem kinaik ka taŋge nuŋe dubinaig taŋgo 11 nane afu turmba maŋgurka minnaig le nane tugum kinaik le kaŋgerka sanikinaig:
O siŋka. Suŋgo nu maŋ tiŋgat. Simon nu kaŋgerat ŋginaig le
nale mata wam ndinŋge promba ka nu Emausŋge bret fetfetna le nale nu kila pilnaik ta ŋakmba kubeu niŋginaik.
Yesus dubinaig mbal afu nu kaŋgernaig
Nale kubemba minnaik le Yesus nu mayok ka nane ŋgamukŋge tiŋgina.
Nane piriri ŋayomba kuru-kuruka mindekanu ŋga idusnaig le
nu nane saniŋgina: Ndaŋam tane piriri ŋayomba wamdus te-sulude.
Ye tuku wai kupe nzilal kaŋgerkap. Pro ye tuku ŋgarosu kiremba kila palpe. Te yeŋge. Mindekanu nane ŋgarosu kugatok ŋgina.
Nu taŋamba saniŋgina sulumba nuŋe wai kupe nzilal tumniŋgina le
nane gare suŋgo tumba ndek wamdus tero ndakinaig le nu nane kusnaniŋgina: Tane nyamagaŋ ŋak e ŋgina le
nane kualegaŋ uganu ande tunaig le
tumba nane am mbolŋge nyina.
Kile Yesus nu nane saniŋgina: Ye o buk tane ndoŋ minmba Moses tuan taŋgo kame ŋakmba tuku kuyar mune kuyar ye tuku kuyarkinaig ta ŋakmba kumuŋgamŋgat ŋga satiŋgen ŋgina.
Taŋamba nu nane kuyar kila pilwaig ŋga nu nane wamdus purfeu serniŋgina sulumba
saniŋgina: Tuan taŋgo kame nane Kristus tuku teŋenmba kuyarnaig: Nu rar suŋgo tumba kumwa sulumba mara keŋnu mbolŋge maŋ tinuŋgat.

Nane afu nu tuku nyu tumba Yerusalemŋge tugu pilmba ka ma ŋakmba mbolŋge kukliwamŋgaig. Kukliwaig le nane ismba ŋgamuŋgal biye mbilwaig le Kuate nu nane tuku une sauka gilaiŋgamŋgat. Nane taŋamba ye tuku kuyarnaig.
Tane wam kame te ŋakmba kile-mayokkamŋgaig.
Tane isap. Mam nu ande prowam tuku sakina ta nu kukuli le tane mbol prowamŋgat. Tane Yerusalem kusre ndawap. Samba mbolok saŋgri tairŋga minap ŋgina.
Kuate nu Yesus te-duŋgina
Kile Yesus nu nane kilmba mayok ka kumba Betani tumbraŋ prona ka taŋge nuŋe wai te-duŋga nane nyaro niŋgina.
Taŋamba minna le Kuate nu te-duŋgina le nane kusreka samba mbol kina.
Taŋana le nane gare tormba luka Yerusalem kinaig sulumba
taŋge nane mara mindek kusem wande suŋgo sinamŋge Kuate tuku nyu te-duŋga minnaig. Son.
